help.output:
usage: run_train.py [-h] [--mode {mx,control}] [--data-root DATA_ROOT]
                    [--output-root OUTPUT_ROOT] [--device {cuda,cuda:0}]
                    [--download] [--stop-after-epoch STOP_AFTER_EPOCH]
                    [--checkpoint CHECKPOINT]
                    {check,run,resume}

Hundred-epoch single-mode MX weight training, with a separately started
matched control. CUDA production; SVHN train only. No warm-start, truncation
or distillation. The original forward function is used with internal selector
[32]; the adapter selects actual MX weights, while activations and the BN bank
remain at A32.

positional arguments:
  {check,run,resume}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --mode {mx,control}
  --data-root DATA_ROOT
  --output-root OUTPUT_ROOT
  --device {cuda,cuda:0}
  --download
  --stop-after-epoch STOP_AFTER_EPOCH
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
